appetite.statement: The Council’s reputation is one of the most important assets which employees and Councillors aim to protect to ensure there is little chance of significant repercussions. This relates primarily to the core business areas. As custodians of the public’s trust and public’s funds, even the transformational activities are delivered with sound governance arrangements in place and follow a strong and consistent corporate project management methodology. However, in the process of seeking the benefits of new ways of achieving or improving outcomes for the residents the Council is seeking an open reputational risk, with possible significant reputational damage or enhancement.

gaps.text: No paper lists agreed audit actions with theme, due date or status. The audit plan report only describes monitoring reports on implementation of agreed recommendations (5.6(b)); the completed-work appendices give opinions and follow-up implementation progress only; the strategy says expected-level actions and deadlines are listed in the risk register, which is not public.

The Strategic / Corporate Risk Register is not among the papers. It is an exempt (Part II, confidential) report; the strategy confirms risk is reported to the Governance Committee as a Part II report. No registered risks, scores or owners are recorded.

The audit plan covering report refers to Appendices A-F (Internal Audit Charter, Internal Audit Strategy, Reporting Protocol, Appendix D Internal Audit Plan 2025 to 2028, Appendix E Anti-Fraud Work Plan 2025/26, Appendix F Quality and Improvement Programme 2025/26), but the file holds only the 7-page covering report. The planned audits, their risk levels, days and last-reviewed dates are therefore absent.
Both completed-work files are Appendix A only; the covering Internal Audit Plan Update Reports (and any narrative on the findings behind each opinion) are not among the papers.
The 2024/25 completed follow-ups table continues on page 2 with a first row that carries no text in any column (only a coloured implementation-progress cell); it is not recorded as an audit.

Appendix 1 para 2.1 of the strategy says the Council adopts the ISO 31000 Guide 73 definition of risk but prints no definition after the colon; Chart 1 (Three lines) and Graph 2 (Risk Management process) carry no extractable text.
The 2025/26 Q3 appendix prints 'None' for completed follow ups and for completed advisory reviews/other work, and both appendices print 'None' under Corporate; these add no audit entries.
